parent_scope_objection: Second and final review, initial1spent per key. Current Discussion explicitly says it replicated the pure-list reward-null finding of Nilsson1987, Ngaosuvan/Mantila2005, Stefanidi2018Exp1 AND shipped Talmi2021. Independent papers can be separate targets when their findings are actually tested; an explicit direct original-specific comparison is strong evidence and null findings are eligible. However codebook also requires the closest study actually re-tested in a replication chain. Current Methods uses the same picture material and modified procedure from shipped Talmi2021; current Introduction explicitly describes Talmi2021 as ALREADY reporting both pure-list reward-null and reward-by-delay-null findings. Thus merely calling older three papers independent by author/year/journal is not sufficient to rule out the chain. Determine whether current actually retests three independent original-specific empirical claims beyond the already represented closest Talmi2021, or collectively cites earlier demonstrations of the SAME pure-list finding already retested in2021. Do not exclude them merely as background, because current own results explicitly compare to them; equally do not treat every cited earlier replication in a shared finding-chain as an extra target. Inspect original task/claim/report relationships as necessary. The immediate pure-list reward reversal and delayed null are current results, not authority to manufacture unrequested outcomes. Identity-only review; retain genuine chain ambiguity if necessary, no forced verdict. No claim that different dates or author teams alone prove separate missing pairs.
